overall_goal: Add parsley to the risotto, stir it, and taste to check the seasoning

goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up parsley from a bowl and sprinkles it into the frying pan.
The person picks up a spatula, stirs the ingredients in the pan, and taps the spatula to remove excess food.
The person uses a teaspoon to scoop up some risotto and tastes it.
